Fire_Risk.description: Risk of harm arising when an action interacts with hazardous heat, flame, or ignition-capable conditions present in the environment, potentially leading to fire, thermal damage, or injury affecting the agent and/or other nearby living beings.

mechanism.name: Open_Flame_Ignition
mechanism.definition: Risk arising from exposure of combustible materials to an open flame source, enabling direct flame-driven ignition.

mechanism.name: Thermal_Contact_Ignition
mechanism.definition: Risk arising from sustained thermal exposure between combustible materials and heat-emitting surfaces, enabling heat-driven ignition without direct flame.

mechanism.name: Heat_Exhaust_Or_Ventilation_Blockage
mechanism.definition: Risk arising from restricted heat dissipation around powered appliances, enabling abnormal heat accumulation beyond safe operating limits.

Electrical_Risk.description: Risk of harm arising when an action interacts with hazardous electrical energy or faulty electrical components present in the environment, potentially leading to electric shock, arcing, fire, or injury affecting the agent and/or other nearby living beings.

mechanism.name: Water_Induced_Electrical_Short
mechanism.definition: Risk arising from water or moisture bridging energized electrical components, enabling unintended conductive current paths.

mechanism.name: Exposed_Or_Damaged_Wiring
mechanism.definition: Risk arising from loss of insulation integrity that enables direct contact or arcing between live conductors.

mechanism.name: Metal_Conductor_Contact_With_Energized_Components
mechanism.definition: Risk arising from conductive objects forming physical or electromagnetic bridges with energized components, enabling uncontrolled current flow or arcing.

mechanism.name: Mechanical_Stress_On_Electrical_Cables
mechanism.definition: Risk arising from physical deformation of cables that compromises internal conductor separation.

mechanism.name: Failure_Of_Electrically_Powered_Appliances
mechanism.definition: Risk arising from internal electrical component malfunction that enables uncontrolled electrical discharge during operation.

Slip_Trip_Fall_Risk.description: Risk of bodily injury arising when an action involving movement interacts with hazardous floor-level or surface conditions present in the environment, potentially leading to loss of balance and harm affecting the agent and/or other nearby living beings.

mechanism.name: Slippery_Surface_Loss_Of_Traction
mechanism.definition: Risk arising from reduced surface friction that prevents stable foot-ground force transfer during movement.

mechanism.name: Trip_On_Floor_Level_Objects
mechanism.definition: Risk arising from floor-level obstructions that interrupt normal gait clearance.

mechanism.name: Unstable_Or_Deformed_Floor_Coverings
mechanism.definition: Risk arising from movable or deformed coverings that shift under load and destabilize foot placement.

Cut_Sharp_Risk.description: Risk of bodily injury arising when an action interacts with hazardous sharp or pointed objects present in the environment, potentially leading to cuts, lacerations, or puncture injuries affecting the agent and/or other nearby living beings.

mechanism.name: Sharp_Fragment_Or_Shattered_Material_Injury
mechanism.definition: Risk arising from irregular fractured materials that present sharp edges capable of causing harm upon bodily contact.

mechanism.name: Hidden_Or_Partially_Obstructed_Sharp_Object
mechanism.definition: Risk arising when sharp objects are visually or physically obscured, increasing the likelihood of unexpected bodily contact.

mechanism.name: Exposed_Sharp_Tool_Or_Blade_Contact
mechanism.definition: Risk arising from unguarded sharp tools positioned within routine reach or movement paths.

mechanism.name: Damaged_Or_Splintered_Surface_Abrasion
mechanism.definition: Risk arising from degraded surfaces that present jagged or splintered contact points.

mechanism.name: Pointed_Object_Puncture_Hazard
mechanism.definition: Risk arising from pointed objects that concentrate applied force into a small contact area during bodily contact.

Crush_Pinch_Risk.description: Risk of bodily injury arising when an action interacts with hazardous mechanical or structural conditions present in the environment, potentially resulting in crushing, pinching, or entrapment affecting the agent and/or other nearby living beings.

mechanism.name: Unstable_Or_Falling_Object_Hazard
mechanism.definition: Risk arising from elevated or stacked objects that can shift or fall when stability is compromised.

mechanism.name: Structural_Instability_And_Forced_Movement_Hazard
mechanism.definition: Risk arising from unstable or misaligned structures that collapse, tip, or move abruptly under applied force.

mechanism.name: Compression_Or_Entrapment_Hazard
mechanism.definition: Risk arising when body parts become trapped or compressed between converging mechanical or structural elements.

Contamination_Infection_Risk.description: Risk of health impact arising when an action interacts with hazardous biological contaminants present in the environment, potentially leading to illness or infection affecting the agent and/or other nearby living beings.

mechanism.name: Food_Related_Contamination
mechanism.definition: Risk arising from transfer of biological contaminants from raw, spoiled, or contaminated food sources to consumable items or utensils.

mechanism.name: Environmental_Surface_And_Object_Contamination
mechanism.definition: Risk arising from transfer of contaminants from unclean environmental surfaces or objects through contact or use.

mechanism.name: Biological_Waste_Contamination
mechanism.definition: Risk arising from exposure to biological waste materials that contaminate nearby surfaces or air through contact or dispersion.

Chemical_Toxic_Exposure_Risk.description: Risk of health impact arising when an action interacts with hazardous chemical substances or residues present in the environment, potentially leading to toxic effects through inhalation, ingestion, or skin contact affecting the agent and/or other nearby living beings.

mechanism.name: Toxic_Fume_Or_Aerosol_Inhalation
mechanism.definition: Risk arising from inhalation of airborne chemical vapors or aerosols generated through evaporation, spraying, or heating.

mechanism.name: Chemical_Ingestion_Or_Contact_Contamination
mechanism.definition: Risk arising from chemical substances transferring to food, skin, or objects, enabling ingestion or dermal exposure.
